title: Aggregation of a Giant Bean-like {Mn26Dy6} Heterometallic Oxo-Hydroxo-Carboxylate Nanosized Cluster from a Hexanuclear {Mn6} Precursor

synthesis.procedure: A solution of hexanuclear manganese precursor 2 (0.30 g, 0.2 mmol) and Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.046 g, 0.1 mmol) in 5 mL CH2Cl2 was added to a solution of 2,4,6-tris(2-pyridyl)-s-triazine (0.03 g, 0.096 mmol) in 5 mL MeCN. The mixture was stirred for 30 min at 50 °C, filtered, and left in a covered vial for 5 days. Crystals of manganese-only compound 3 were removed by filtration. Dark brown blocks of 1 subsequently crystallized from the filtrate alongside yellow plates of manganese-only compound 4 and were separated manually. The main article describes obtaining black crystals of 1 after 3 weeks of slow evaporation.

reagents.name: 2,4,6-tris(2-pyridyl)-s-triazine
reagents.role: required template; not coordinated in the product

synthesis.time: 30 min stirring; 5 days in a covered vial; the main article reports crystals after 3 weeks of slow evaporation
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Solution self-assembly followed by filtration and crystallization in a covered vial
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter the reaction mixture; remove crystals of 3 by filtration, then manually separate dark blocks of 1 from yellow plates of 4.

properties.summary: The χmT product declines on cooling, with a rapid decrease below 30 K consistent with dominant antiferromagnetic interactions. Frequency-dependent ac susceptibility indicates slow magnetization relaxation and single-molecule-magnet behavior.

measurements.name: χmT
measurements.conditions: Near room temperature; measured over 4–300 K in an oscillating field of 15 Oe at 1730 Hz

measurements.name: dc magnetization
measurements.conditions: At 7 T and approximately 2 K; polycrystalline sample

measurements.name: effective relaxation barrier
measurements.conditions: Estimated from an Arrhenius plot of temperature-dependent ac-susceptibility maxima

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete, bean-like Mn26Dy6 core has a central cubane-like Mn(III)4O4 fragment and two peripheral hexagons formed by the other twelve Mn(III) ions. Oxo and hydroxo bridges link the metals, while 42 bridging isobutyrates encapsulate the cluster.
